|------------|---------|-------------|---------------------|

| **Hawksmoor** | Steakhouse | £25–£45 per person | Known for high‑quality cuts, a relaxed atmosphere, and a good selection of whiskies. |
| **Padella** | Italian (pasta) | £10–£20 per person | Fresh hand‑made pasta, quick service, and a loyal following. |
| **Sketch** | French/Modern | £50–£80 per person | Unique décor, Michelin‑starred dining, and a whimsical “pink room.” |
| **Borough Market** | Food Hall | Varies | A bustling market with dozens of stalls offering everything from artisanal cheese to gourmet street food. |
